name: Disable Fast Startup (Hybrid Shutdown)
description: Makes Shut Down mean a genuine full shutdown instead of hibernating the kernel session. Boot takes a few seconds longer, but dual-boot filesystems stop being left dirty and driver changes actually take effect after a shutdown.

name: Enable Fast Startup (Hybrid Shutdown)
description: Restores hybrid shutdown, which saves the kernel session to hiberfil.sys so the next cold boot is faster. Requires hibernation to be enabled.

name: Disable Power Throttling
description: Stops Windows parking background threads on efficiency cores and clocking them down. Helps long-running background work finish on time; costs battery life on a laptop.

name: Enable Power Throttling
description: Lets Windows throttle background threads again to save power. This is the default and the right setting on battery-powered hardware.

name: Show Hibernate in the Power Menu
description: Adds Hibernate alongside Sleep and Shut Down in the Start power menu. Requires hibernation to be enabled first.

name: Hide Sleep in the Power Menu
description: Removes Sleep from the Start power menu, useful on a machine whose hardware does not resume from sleep reliably.

name: Disable Modern Standby (S0 Low Power Idle)
description: Turns off connected standby so the machine uses the classic S3 sleep state, if the firmware still offers it. This is the usual fix for a laptop that runs hot and drains its battery inside a closed bag.

name: Disable Wake Timers
description: Stops scheduled tasks and background maintenance waking the machine from sleep. Windows Update installs then wait until you are actually using the PC.

detect.script: try { $o = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_SLEEP RTCWAKE | Out-String; if ($o -match 'Current AC Power Setting Index:\s*0x00000000') {'True'} else {'False'} } catch { 'error' }
detect.applied_reason: wake timers are disabled on the active power plan
detect.not_applied_reason: wake timers are still allowed on the active power plan

name: Disable USB Selective Suspend
description: Stops Windows powering down idle USB ports. Fixes audio interfaces, DACs and wireless dongles that drop out after a few minutes idle, at a small cost in battery life.

detect.script: try { $o = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT 2a737441-1930-4402-8d77-b2bebba308a3 48e6b7a6-50f5-4782-a5d4-53bb8f07e226 | Out-String; if ($o -match 'Current AC Power Setting Index:\s*0x00000000') {'True'} else {'False'} } catch { 'error' }
detect.applied_reason: USB selective suspend is off on the active power plan
detect.not_applied_reason: USB selective suspend is still enabled on the active power plan

name: Disable PCI Express Link State Power Management
description: Stops PCIe devices dropping into low-power link states. A common fix for stuttering NVMe drives, network adapters and capture cards, and a measurable battery cost on a laptop.

detect.script: try { $o = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT 501a4d13-42af-4429-9fd1-a8218c268e20 ee12f906-d277-404b-b6da-e5fa1a576df5 | Out-String; if ($o -match 'Current AC Power Setting Index:\s*0x00000000') {'True'} else {'False'} } catch { 'error' }
detect.applied_reason: PCIe link state power management is off on AC
detect.not_applied_reason: PCIe link state power management is still active on AC

name: Never Turn Off the Hard Disk
description: Stops Windows spinning drives down after an idle period, which removes the pause when you next touch a mechanical disk. Has no effect on SSDs beyond a small idle power cost.

detect.script: try { $o = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_DISK DISKIDLE | Out-String; if ($o -match 'Current AC Power Setting Index:\s*0x00000000') {'True'} else {'False'} } catch { 'error' }
detect.applied_reason: the AC disk idle timeout is 0 (never)
detect.not_applied_reason: the AC disk idle timeout is still set

name: Unhide Advanced Processor Power Settings
description: Makes the hidden minimum/maximum processor state, core parking and performance boost options visible in the advanced power plan dialog, so they can be tuned by hand.

name: Unhide Core Parking Settings
description: Exposes the processor core parking minimum and maximum sliders in the advanced power plan dialog.

name: Unhide Hibernate and Hybrid Sleep Settings
description: Exposes the hibernate-after and hybrid-sleep options in the advanced power plan dialog, which Windows hides on machines using modern standby.

name: Use the Balanced Power Plan
description: Switches to the Balanced scheme, which scales clocks with demand. This is the right default for a laptop and for most desktops.

detect.applied_reason: the active power plan is Balanced
detect.not_applied_reason: the active power plan is not Balanced

name: Do Nothing When the Laptop Lid Closes
description: Stops the machine sleeping when you shut the lid, for laptops used as a desktop with an external monitor. Make sure the machine has airflow when closed.

detect.script: try { $o = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT 4f971e89-eebd-4455-a8de-9e59040e7347 5ca83367-6e45-459f-a27b-476b1d01c936 | Out-String; if ($o -match 'Current AC Power Setting Index:\s*0x00000000') {'True'} else {'False'} } catch { 'error' }
detect.applied_reason: closing the lid does nothing while on AC power
detect.not_applied_reason: closing the lid still triggers a power action on AC

name: Require a Password on Wake
description: Makes Windows ask for your password when it comes back from sleep. Without this, anyone who opens the lid is already signed in as you.

name: Disable Per-App Energy Estimation
description: Stops Windows continuously accounting for each app's power draw to fill in the battery-usage report. Removes a small always-on background cost.

name: Disable the Sleep Study Trace
description: Turns off the ETW trace Windows keeps running to build the modern-standby sleep study report.

name: Turn Off Hibernation and Reclaim hiberfil.sys
description: Disables hibernation and deletes hiberfil.sys, which is normally sized at about 40 percent of installed RAM. Fast Startup depends on hibernation, so it is switched off too.

name: Turn Hibernation Back On
description: Re-enables hibernation and recreates hiberfil.sys, which is also what Fast Startup needs in order to work.

name: Use a Reduced-Size Hibernation File
description: Shrinks hiberfil.sys to the size Fast Startup needs, roughly 20 percent of RAM. Full hibernation stops working; hybrid shutdown keeps working.

name: Disable Adaptive Brightness
description: Stops Windows changing screen brightness in response to the ambient light sensor or on-screen content.

detect.script: try { $o = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT 7516b95f-f776-4464-8c53-06167f40cc99 fbd9aa66-9553-4097-ba44-ed6e9d65eab8 | Out-String; if ($o -match 'Current AC Power Setting Index:\s*0x00000000') {'True'} else {'False'} } catch { 'error' }
detect.applied_reason: adaptive brightness is off on AC power
detect.not_applied_reason: adaptive brightness is still enabled on AC power

name: Stop Battery Saver Dimming the Screen
description: Keeps the display at full brightness when battery saver kicks in, instead of dropping it to 70 percent.

name: Disconnect the Network During Modern Standby
description: Stops Wi-Fi staying connected while the machine is in modern standby, which is what lets background apps keep the radio and CPU busy in your bag.

detect.script: try { $o = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT 238c9fa8-0aad-41ed-83f4-97be242c8f20 f15576e8-98b7-4186-b944-eafa664402d9 | Out-String; if ($o -match 'Current DC Power Setting Index:\s*0x00000000') {'True'} else {'False'} } catch { 'error' }
detect.applied_reason: networking is disconnected during standby on battery
detect.not_applied_reason: networking stays connected during standby on battery
